name: RotatePoint
formula: =LAMBDA(point,deg,x_center,y_center,TOROW(LET(author, "Kinen Ma & Lucas Leung", version_date, "v2, 2025-09-05", x, INDEX(point, 1, 1), y, INDEX(point, 1, 2), rad, RADIANS(deg), rotation_matric, VSTACK(HSTACK(COS(rad), -SIN(rad)), HSTACK(SIN(rad), COS(rad))), x0, x - x_center, y0, y - y_center, coor_matrix, VSTACK(x0, y0), res_matrix2, MMULT(rotation_matric, coor_matrix), res_matrix, res_matrix2 + VSTACK(x_center, y_center), output, res_matrix, output)))
comment: Rotate a point through another point by some degrees. ROTATEPOINT(float, float, float, float, float, optional string:{"x", "y"})
